01. Background and Demand:
The seat belt is often referred to as the "life belt," ser ving as the most fundamental and critical
occupant protection device during car accidents.Statistics show that wearing a seat belt can reduce
the mortality rate by 57% in frontal collisions, 44% in side impac

ion device during car accidents.Statistics show that wearing a seat belt can reduce
the mortality rate by 57% in frontal collisions, 44% in side impacts, and 80% in rollover accidents.
Many countries have made it mandator y for drivers and passengers to wear seat belts, imposing
fines for non-compliance. The purpose of the seat belt detection system is to utilize IoT technology
for effective seat belt management, reminding passengers to wear seat belts and reducing
secondar y injuries caused by accidents.
02. System Topology Introduction:
1. Seat cushion sensor and seat belt socket The seat cushion sensor detects whether someone is
sitting in the seat, the seat belt socket detects whether the passenger's seat belt is fastened, and
the detection result is output to the detection terminal.
2. Terminal detection The detection terminal packages the detection results of the seat cushion
senso

tion result is output to the detection terminal.
2. Terminal detection The detection terminal packages the detection results of the seat cushion
sensor and seat belt socket, and sends them to the safety reminder host through wireless signals at
regular inter vals. One detection terminal can detect the status information of one or two seats.
3. Seat belt host The seat belt host receives signals from the detection terminal, displays the results
on the screen, and outputs audio signals to drive the car speaker through the car amplifier,
reminding passengers who have not fastened their seat belts to do so. The data is uploaded to the
backend system through the 4G network .
4. Backend system and mini program Administrators can remotely view the seat and seat belt
fastening status of vehicles in the backend system, per form location queries, and remotely manage
device

Product Description
The offered Forklift Fork Caddy (His-flws-043) is a manually driven tool that makes it very easier to
move the heavy duty truck forks to different locations. It can also be used for the installation and
removal of the forks on the vehicle. It is fixed with a set of swivel castor wheels that makes it
suitable for dry as well as wet floors. The steering handle of this mechanical tool is provided with
gripper for better gripping and hold over this industrial tool.

This caddy also allows the user to easily remove and install forks onto a fork truck.

Product Description
Forklift Laser Alignment System
Forklift Laser Alignment System makes use of an integrated laser so as to assist the fork lifters to
guide forking with preciseness when lifting objects. The alignment system is a boon for fork lifting
industry. This is resistant to water & impact and has compatibility with all forklift carriage sizes.
Forklift Laser Alignment System is accessible with a rechargeable battery pack and gets connected
to many forklifts electrical system. This is provided with a greater productivity and ensures
profitability in many applications. All pointy forks can be guided in a safe and accurate way. This
waterproof system ensures innocuous and risk-free loading of pallets.

Product Description
A forklift red zone light, also known as a forklift safety light or red zone warning light, is a safety
feature designed to enhance the visibility of a forklift and create a safe zone around it. The purpose
is to alert pedestrians and other workers in the vicinity about the presence of the forklift and the
potential danger zone.

s how the forklift red zone light typically works:
1. Mounting:
The red zone light is usually mounted on the forklift, facing the ground, near the front or rear of the
vehicle.
2. Projection of Red Zone:
When activated, the light projects a red pattern or zone onto the ground around the forklift. This red
zone serves as a visual indicator of the forklift's presence and warns people to stay a safe distance
away.
3. Movement Activation:
In some models, the red zone light may be activated automatically when the forklift is in operation
or when the operator engages certain functions, such as lifting or reversing.

Product Description
While working in dim lighting, the forklift revolving warning light is a fantastic method to improve
safety and visibility. This light has a bright, red LED light that rotates 360 degrees and is made to
install on the outside of the forklift. In addition to a 12-volt adaptor that may be connected into a
regular outlet, this light is battery-operated. Also, the lamp has a built-in timer that will cause it to
shut off automatically after a set amount of time. This excellent safety feature can aid in reducing
workplace accidents. This product is also used as a warning alarm.

Product Description
A forklift truck reverse warning alarm, commonly known as a backup alarm or backup beeper, is a
safety feature installed on forklifts and other heavy equipment to alert pedestrians and other
workers in the vicinity when the forklift is moving in reverse. The purpose of this alarm is to reduce
the risk of accidents and collisions, as reversing forklifts can be a significant hazard in industrial and
warehouse settings.
Key features and information about forklift reverse warning alarms:
1. Audible Warning:
These alarms emit a loud, distinctive sound when the forklift is in reverse. The sound is typically a
continuous or intermittent beep or a series of beeps. The sound is designed to be
attention-grabbing and easily

Many countries and regions have regulations and standards governing the use of backup alarms on
forklifts and other industrial vehicles. These regulations often specify the minimum sound level, the
type of sound (e.g., beeping), and other requirements.
3. Variability:
Some backup alarms have adjustable sound levels to account for different noise levels in different
work environments. This allows the operator to increase or decrease the volume as needed.
4. Power Source:
Forklift reverse warning alarms are typically powered by the vehicle's electrical system, but some
models may have their own battery or power source.

5. Automatic Activation:
The alarm is usually set to activate automatically when the forklift is shifted into reverse gear. This
ensures that the warning is always sounded when the forklift is moving backward.
6. Manual Override:
Some forklifts have a manual override feature that allows the operator to turn off the alarm
temporarily when necessary. However, this should be used with caution and only in situations
where safety is not compromised.
7. Visual Indicators:
In addition to sound, some alarms also come with visual indicators, such as flashing lights, to
further enhance safety.

Regular maintenance and testing are important to ensure that the alarm is functioning correctly.
